original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC management view reports the correct processor name, model, manufacturer, total physical cores and total threads for the exact SUT.
original_method: Bind SUT/BMC identity, query the supported read-only processor resource or capture the Web UI, collect same-host lscpu/SMBIOS evidence, normalize socket/core/thread scope, and compare every required field with the approved recipe.
manual_activity: If no supported inventory API exists, an operator must capture the exact Web UI fields; otherwise the agent can perform the read-only collection after schema, credentials and recipe are supplied.
required_inputs: Documented processor inventory endpoint or Web UI path
Rules for disabled cores and SMT
safety_requirements: Never use SDR/sensor output as CPU inventory
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Verify SUT/BMC identity and supported schema
Collect raw BMC processor resources or archive operator UI capture
Normalize and compare all five required fields
Report mismatches without changing configuration or deciding verdict
engineer_actions: Supply schema/UI reference and authoritative recipe

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve raw BMC, OS/SMBIOS and recipe values in a socket-aware comparison table with firmware and timestamps.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor API may satisfy the data portion only if the project accepts it as equivalent to the named Web UI; otherwise retain a UI capture checkpoint.
expected_evidence: Raw processor endpoint or full Web UI capture
Approved recipe and normalized per-field comparison
No settings/log changes or hardware PASS claim
